Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class FileLineIndex

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.FileLineIndex
public final class FileLineIndex extends Object
A sparse, bounded index from 1-based line numbers to byte offsets in one UTF-8 text file that may keep growing while it is read.

The index keeps one offset per stride lines. When maxEntries offsets are held, the stride doubles and every other entry is dropped, so memory stays at most maxEntries longs whatever the file size. A seek(long) scans at most stride - 1 lines from the nearest entry. refresh() reads only bytes appended since the previous call.

The index resets (new epoch) when the file key changes (replaced or rotated by rename), when the file shrinks below the indexed size (truncated), or when its first bytes change (rewritten in place). A copy-truncate that regrows past the old indexed size with byte-identical first 64 bytes before the next refresh() cannot be detected; rotate logs by rename instead.

Thread-safe. Keep one instance per log file and share it across requests; otherwise every request re-scans the file from byte 0.

Example:

FileLineIndex index = FileLineIndex.of(logFile); FileLineIndex.Snapshot s = index.refresh(); long offset = index.seek(s.indexedLines());

Since:
10.0.0
